stories.title: U.S. Disrupts Xinbi Guarantee Scam Marketplace, Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto
stories.description: U.S. authorities disrupted Xinbi Guarantee and froze $52.8 million in crypto tied to the scam marketplace and its merchant network.

stories.title: Scans for Proxmox Servers, (Wed, Sep 9th)
stories.description: About a week ago, Proxmox published an advisory revealing a vulnerability in older versions of Proxmox VE, its flagship Virtual Environment product. The vulnerability only affects version 7, which has not been supported for a couple of years now.

stories.title: HelmGuard Raises $7.3 Million for Agentic GRC and Security
stories.description: The company will increase its US market presence and will expand its engineering and go-to-market teams.

stories.title: AI Is Giving Lesser-Resourced Attackers Nation-State-Level Reach, Google Warns
stories.description: Criminal and state-sponsored adversaries are increasingly using AI to automate and scale their attacks, according to GTIG.

stories.title: Veradigm Confirms Patient Data Exposed in Third-Party Data Breach
stories.description: Healthcare technology company Veradigm Inc. has disclosed that a cybersecurity incident at one of its third-party vendors led to the exposure of sensitive patient data, including Social Security numbers, for a limited group of the company's customers.

stories.title: Four Spy Groups Used the Same Chrome and Windows Exploit Kit Within a Week
stories.description: BlueMoon chains two Chrome V8 zero-days with a Windows flaw in phishing attacks used by APT31 and other espionage clusters.

stories.title: Android’s September 2026 Updates Patch 180 Vulnerabilities
stories.description: The security updates resolve critical flaws across Android’s Framework, System, and Kernel components.

stories.title: New N0va Phishkit Targets North America and EU: A Growing Identity Risk for SOCs
stories.description: Recently, ANY.RUN researchers uncovered N0va, a new phishkit targeting organizations across North America and the EU, including government, technology, consulting, and healthcare.

stories.description: Major chipmakers announced patches for vulnerabilities recently discovered in their products.

stories.title: Infostealer Logs Expose Replayable AI Tokens That Can Bypass MFA
stories.description: Infostealer logs expose replayable AI session tokens and API keys that can bypass login controls and enable unauthorized account access.
